thread:
sam: quick ask — can we open a 5% canary for the reranker_v3 ab toggle today? low-risk smoke, want to validate latency + top-k quality before 50%.
maya: do we know audience overlap with the mid-month personalization experiment? last time those two collided and skewed metrics.
sam: good call. proposed audience: US users, exclude user_segment: personalization_midmonth. also exclude internal/stage accounts.
jordan: +1 but make sure seed is stable across splits. if we just rely on feature flag percent there's some nondeterminism between services.
liam: what's the guardrail? we should have concrete stop rules (latency, error spike, quality drop).
sam: proposed guardrails:
- abort if p95 latency increases > 40ms vs baseline
- abort if error rate increases > 0.5% absolute
- abort if rerank CTR drops > 2% (on the canary slice)
anya: can we add a secondary quality check — sample 500 requests and run manual evals? also log a small prompt set to S3 for eval replay.
sam: yes, adding manual_eval_sample=500. I'll push the eval set to s3://redwood-canary/reranker_v3/1859991234
jordan: config snippet for ops (copy for the rollout playbook):
```yaml
flag: reranker_v3_ab
percent: 5
audience:
  include:
    - country: US
  exclude:
    - user_segment: personalization_midmonth
    - role: internal
guardrails:
  p95_latency_ms: 40 # delta vs baseline
  error_rate_pct: 0.5
  ctr_drop_pct: 2.0
manual_eval_sample: 500
seed: 42
```
liam: CLI to flip (ops run):
`redwood flags set reranker_v3_ab --percent 5 --audience "country=US,exclude=personalization_midmonth,exclude=internal" --seed 42 --meta "canary:smoke-1859991234"`
maya: also add a small audience overlap check before enabling — run this query PR: "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM experiments WHERE experiment IN ('personalization_midmonth','reranker_v3_ab') AND country='US'" — aim for <0.1% overlap.
sam: will run overlap check now and paste results.
deploy-bot: scheduled rollout job created by sam — job_id: job-rr3-1859991234 — scheduled start: 2026-09-14T15:30:00Z
sam: overlap check result: 0.03% (13k overlapping users out of 42M US DAU) — within acceptable bounds.
anya: perf dashboards to watch: /dashboards/reranker_v3/latency, /dashboards/reranker_v3/errors, /dashboards/reranker_v3/quality_topk. I'll add a pinned note with the thresholds.
liam: small oops: make sure the canary bucket is routed to the same inference tier (gpu-small) — otherwise latency delta will be meaningless.
sam: yep it's pinned to gpu-small in the rollout config.
jordan: plan: 5% -> monitor 30m -> if clean 24h ramp to 25% -> monitor 24h -> decide on 50%. stop rules as above. document in the rollout playbook.
maya: pinging analytics for quick sanity check on metric instrumentation — @analytics could we get a 30min look after start?
sam: thanks all. I'll run the CLI at start time and post updates in this thread. tagging runbook: #runbooks/reranker_canary
maya: :thumbsup:
liam: :eyes: good luck
anya: thanks, will review the manual eval samples when they're uploaded.
